scope: Automated headless Chromium + IWER 2.6.0 Meta Quest 3 emulation; temporary SQLite DB; not a physical headset, comfort or device-performance test.
checks: Desktop without headset: truthful capability state and disabled entry
Desktop cockpit: begin, select, designate, classify, arm, cancel, confirm and pause
Closing preview restores ordinary renderer; decisions saved and server verified
Emulated permission denial is recoverable and creates no live session
Emulated XR frame contains separate left-eye and right-eye views
Both emulated controllers raycast scene buttons; selection, type, identity, classification and response reach worker
Pending response expires after eight seconds and requires a separate confirmation
Emulated visibility loss pauses simulation; visible again never auto-resumes
Controller exit and headset/system exit pause training; re-entry works
Natural full-duration VR exercise ends session, opens debrief and is independently server verified
Graphics context loss exits immersive mode and pauses the drill
